description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Czech Republic working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when czech Republic 2026 statutory rest-day facts over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. This is not a universal legal weekly roster. No shift, individual employer, bank/exchange, school, retail opening, payroll or legal-deadline schedule is computed. Commemorative days do not add rest; no substitute Monday is inferred. Future-year coverage is not asserted.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Czech Republic authority-scope working days in exact coverage. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; commemorative events do not create rest.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Czech Republic working days around Two names on January 1, one rest date. | Add or subtract Czech Republic working days around Education commemorative day remains a planning workday. | Add or subtract Czech Republic working days around November 17 is a Czech statutory rest day.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0,"work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_state_holiday, is_other_holiday, is_statutory_holiday, is_commemorative_day, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no state_holiday AND no other_holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/czech-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/czech-public-add-working-days.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline, not a statutory universal roster.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_cz_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Czech Republic 2026 statutory holidays with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: state_holiday, other_holiday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; commemorations alone do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_commemorative_day.description: Whether result.date has a section 4 event effective at that occurrence; does not add rest.

is_other_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a section 2 other holiday.

is_state_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a section 1 state holiday.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a statutory holiday under section 1 or 2.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Czech Republic Working Days
